messages:
eng_maya: rolling out prompt-bridge (new prompt-routing endpoint) to canary=10% in us-east now. deploy id deploy/2026-03-10/pb-42. watching latency and 5xx. please stand by.

deploy-bot: :rocket: started deploy deploy/2026-03-10/pb-42 -> canary 10% (us-east)

incident-bot: :rotating_light: automated alert — 5xx spike detected on /v1/prompt-route (us-east). baseline 4.8% -> 12.3% over 60s. paging @sre_jamie

sre_jamie: oncall here, looking at logs now. can someone post the canary config?

eng_noah: pulling traces — not a GC issue. seeing KV cache miss rate jump and increased backend latency for prompt-bridge upstream (router->embedder). stacktrace-ish: high tail latency in embedder pool.

eng_maya: hmm. thanks. I'm going to flip the prompt-bridge feature flag off for canary to force traffic back to stable-router while we triage. @infra_noah can you watch routing as I flip?

pm_kevin: noted. Support, brace for customer impact; some completions may have high latency/failures during the window. @support_amy

support_amy: starting customer-impact queries (by org and by path). ETA ~10m to get list and severity buckets. will prepare templated status updates.

eng_maya: executing flag flip now — command below:
```bash
# flip prompt-bridge for canary only
curl -X POST https://console.internal/flags/prompt-bridge/toggle \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REPLACE_ME" \\n  -d '{"state":"off","scope":"canary"}'
```

infra_noah: received request, applying to router plane. patching routing table for canary tier. watching ack from proxies.

deploy-bot: feature-flag:update ack prompt-bridge -> state:off (scope: canary) id:ff-2026-110 :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: routing fallback: prompt-bridge traffic in canary now routed to stable-router v1.23. automatic circuit-breaker engaged for failing upstreams.

sre_jamie: 5xx and lat spikes falling — 5xx down to 0.9% in the last 2m, p50/p95 latency back to baseline. continuing to monitor for 15m.

eng_lead_carla: great mitigation. let's abort further rollouts and mark this canary as failed. @eng_maya please open a rollback/abort ticket and stop any queued promotion jobs.

eng_maya: opened rollback ticket INC-9875 (https://redwood.internal/INC-9875) and cancelled promotion pipeline for pb-42. also created a short runbook note under the ticket with the flag flip command and observed metrics.

sre_jamie: switching to monitoring-only. leaving handoff note in incident ticket and will add logs and flamegraphs. handing off to next oncall for night shift. @sre_kim can you take next 2h watch?

sre_kim: ack — taking over monitoring. will collect additional traces and look for any residual errors. please DM any suspicious traces.

pm_kevin: support update: no persistent data loss, impact limited to request failures/latency during canary window. sending curated list of affected orgs to CSMs in 15m.

support_amy: drafted message and posting to #customer-updates now. will tag top-tier customers and the CSM rotation.

eng_maya: owners for postmortem: eng_noah (root cause) + sre_kim (ops timeline). I'll sync with PM and support to include customer impact and rollout gating changes.

eng_noah: preliminary hypothesis: routing change in prompt-bridge introduced a backend path that increased KV miss amplification under 10% canary traffic. need deeper perf profiling + replay on staging.

infra_noah: router metrics and logs collected to S3 prefix s3://redwood-incidents/INC-9875/1769456789/ (configs, routing-table snapshots, proxy logs).

eng_lead_carla: applause to the team for fast FF flip and clear handoff. next steps: detailed timeline, repro, and a gating checklist before next attempt.

sre_kim: will run 2h watch and then compile logs for the postmortem. ping me if any anomalies.

eng_maya: closing this thread for now — will update INC-9875 and create a short retrospective doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:
